Title: Aston Martin debuts ‘Dreadnought’ SUV in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 ahead of October launch
Synopsis: Aston Martin has unveiled the virtual Dreadnought SUV for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4. This military-inspired vehicle will be accessible in select game modes upon release. Players can locate and use the Dreadnought directly within the game's environments. The digital SUV blends Aston Martin's signature styling with tactical gameplay features. It will be available on multiple gaming platforms when the title launches globally.

Title: India's first hydrogen train: 1,200-kW fuel cell, zero emissions, advanced safety and other salient features
Synopsis: New Delhi received its first hydrogen-powered train on Friday. Prime Minister Narendra Modi flagged the passenger service from Jind railway station. This train will operate between Jind and Sonipat covering 89 kilometers. It features a 1,200-kilowatt hydrogen-fuel-cell-propulsion system for power. The train eliminates tailpipe emissions and lowers fossil fuel dependence.

Title: Facebook Down? Why are users reporting login failures and widespread access issues worldwide
Synopsis: Facebook Down (Google Trends): Facebook experienced a significant outage on Sunday, impacting users worldwide. Many users could not log in or access essential platform features. Some encountered temporary account unavailability messages, causing frustration. The disruption affected multiple countries, including India and the United Kingdom. Mobile access remained functional for some users during the widespread issue.

Title: 2026 Maruti Brezza facelift launching on July 24: Expected price, Boosterjet engine, panoramic sunroof, features and all you need to know
Synopsis: Maruti Brezza facelift (Google Trends): Maruti Suzuki will launch the 2026 Brezza facelift on July 24. The updated SUV receives cosmetic changes and new interior features. A potential 1.0-litre Boosterjet turbo-petrol engine may also debut. Existing safety features are expected to remain strong for buyers. This facelift aims to enhance its competitive edge in the market.

Title: Maruti Suzuki's no-frills cars once ruled India. Then buyers demanded frills as market share drops to near all-time low
Synopsis: For years, Suzuki reigned supreme in India's automotive landscape, but changing buyer interests are challenging this status. As consumers increasingly favor larger, feature-rich vehicles over mere economical transport, Suzuki's focus on affordability seems outdated. To address this trend, Maruti Suzuki is gearing up to release a lineup of modern SUVs and updated models aimed at appealing to the next generation of car buyers.

Title: FIFA World Cup 2026: Lamine Yamal, Pelé, Mbappé and more, all-time youngest players to feature in finals
Synopsis: Who Is the Youngest Player to Play in a FIFA World Cup Final: With the upcoming final, Spain's Lamine Yamal and Pau Cubarsí are poised to etch their names into the World Cup record books as the youngest-ever finalists. They step into a rarefied circle of players under twenty, sharing the stage with legends like Pelé from 1958 and Kylian Mbappé from 2018, showcasing the vibrant potential of Spain’s emerging football talents.

Title: National Film Awards 2026 winners: Kartik Aaryan and Mammootty named Best Actor, Yami Gautam bags Best Actress honour. Check complete list
Synopsis: The winners of the 72nd National Film Awards are being announced in New Delhi, celebrating the best of Indian cinema across feature films, non-feature films and writing on cinema for films certified in 2024. The article highlights the latest winners announced by the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting, including key regional and technical honours, and features a category-wise winners list that will be updated as more awards are revealed.

Title: Tiruppur knitwear units work overtime for CM Vijay's farewell film 'Jana Nayagan'
Synopsis: Garment units in Tirupur are working overtime to meet demand for fan T-shirts. Customised T-shirts feature actor-politician C Joseph Vijay and movie branding. Over 700 knitwear units are involved in this T-shirt production rush. Orders are pouring in from Tamil Nadu and neighboring states. The film 'Jana Nayagan' is set for a grand theatrical release on July 23.

Title: FIFA World Cup 2026 Final halftime show: Who is performing, how long will it last, and how much will Shakira and others be paid?
Synopsis: The FIFA World Cup 2026 Final will feature a historic halftime show with global music icons. Shakira and Burna Boy will perform the official World Cup song, celebrating unity. The extensive lineup includes Justin Bieber, Madonna, and BTS, among others. Performers are not receiving a fixed fee but gain massive global exposure. This groundbreaking entertainment spectacle will last approximately eleven minutes.

Title: Yami Gautam bags career's first National Film Award for Article 370; here's where you can watch it online
Synopsis: Yami Gautam has achieved a major career milestone by winning her first National Film Award, taking home the Best Actress honour for her performance in Article 370 at the 72nd National Film Awards. The political action thriller also emerged as one of the biggest winners of the ceremony by claiming the Best Feature Film award. Here's a look at the film's National Award success, what it's about, and where you can stream it online.

Title: iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max: Expected price in India, colours, camera upgrades, specifications, features and everything we know so far
Synopsis: Apple's upcoming iPhone 18 Pro models are anticipated to feature battery and camera enhancements. The devices are expected to retain a similar design with a potential new Dark Cherry finish. A more powerful A20 Pro chip will likely drive improved performance and AI capabilities. Battery capacity may increase, leading to a slightly thicker and heavier phone. Pricing in India is projected to start around Rs 1,39,900 for the Pro model.

Title: EU forces Google to share search data, open Android to rival AI companies
Synopsis: In the latest attempt to rein in tech behemoths' deep control of the digital economy, the EU said it will support innovation and diversity in the field by enabling fair access to AI features on Android devices and search engines.

Title: Air India revamps app with faster bookings, disruption support
Synopsis: Air India has updated its mobile application with new features for travelers. The enhanced app offers quicker responses and India-specific payment system innovations. Passengers will receive hotel and transportation assistance during flight disruptions. An in-house booking engine provides a faster and more responsive user interface. This digital transformation supports Air India's ambitious modernization plan since its acquisition.

Title: IRCTC new website launched: Check new train ticket booking features and upgrades here
Synopsis: IRCTC New Website Launched: The IRCTC ticket booking website has been redesigned for improved performance. Passengers will experience faster page loads and higher booking capacity starting today. New features include seat preferences and a fare calendar for user convenience. The upgraded platform supports multiple Indian languages and integrates concession bookings. This relaunch is part of broader Indian Railways reforms for better infrastructure.

Title: Centre examining legal implications, possible clauses over WhatsApp, Telegram 'username' feature: Sources
Synopsis: The government is examining legal implications for WhatsApp and Telegram. This follows their replies to notices regarding the new username feature. Concerns about privacy and potential misuse have been raised by experts. Meta stated usernames are optional and allow messaging without sharing phone numbers. The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology is expected to issue a formal notification soon.

Title: Kia Syros EV unveiled with assured buyback: Pre-bookings open today at Rs 25,000; check features, range, battery, charging time, colours and more
Synopsis: Kia Syros EV unveiled: Kia India has unveiled its second electric vehicle, the Syros EV, for the Indian market. Pre-bookings are now open for the electric SUV, which offers two battery pack options. The vehicle boasts an ARAI-certified range of up to 526 kilometers on a single charge. Kia is also providing a lifetime high-voltage battery warranty and financing options.

Title: Maruti Suzuki Brezza Facelift Expected Price: Bookings now open; check launch date, exterior & interior updates, and new features
Synopsis: Maruti Suzuki has opened bookings for the upcoming Brezza facelift. The updated compact SUV will feature a new 1.0-litre Boosterjet turbo-petrol engine. Exterior styling will see minor revisions and new alloy wheels. Inside, customers can expect a larger touchscreen and ventilated seats. The refreshed Brezza is expected to launch on July 24.

Title: McDonald’s limited-time summer launches are here: New Caesar Chicken menu and BT21 Happy Meal revealed
Synopsis: McDonald's is launching a new Caesar Sauce lineup with upgraded chicken favorites. This creamy sauce features parmesan, garlic, and lemon flavors for added taste. Customers can enjoy the new Caesar Snack Wrap and Bacon Caesar McCrispy Sandwich. Additionally, a BT21 Happy Meal collaboration offers collectible toys from BTS characters.

Title: UK announces social media curfew for older teens
Synopsis: The UK government will implement an overnight social media curfew for teenagers aged sixteen and seventeen. This new measure aims to protect young people from addictive online features and promote better sleep. Additionally, plans include disabling addictive features like infinite scrolling for older teenagers. These changes follow a recent ban on social media for children under sixteen. Similar bans have been introduced in other countries like Australia and Canada.

Title: What makes a face attractive? Scientists analysed 600 people to find the features that stand out. Psychology explains why
Synopsis: A new scientific study analysing 601 faces using 3D scans has identified the facial features most commonly linked with attractiveness. Researchers found that slimmer faces, fuller lips and defined features were rated higher in women, while stronger chins and angular facial structures stood out in men. Psychology also suggests that first impressions, facial symmetry, familiarity and evolutionary factors all influence how people perceive attractiveness.

Title: Renault Duster Adventure Edition launched in India at Rs 12.99 lakh: Check new features, cosmetic upgrades, engine options and everything buyers need to know
Synopsis: Renault Duster Adventure Edition Price: The Renault Duster Adventure Edition has officially launched in India at Rs 12.99 lakh (ex-showroom) for the petrol variant. This special edition SUV features new outdoors-inspired styling elements and accessories. It is based on the mid-spec variant and offers a more rugged appearance. The vehicle retains the same engine and transmission options as the standard model.

Title: Google probed by Swiss regulator over Android default search feature
Synopsis: The "Choice Screen" feature allows users to choose ⁠their default ⁠search engines during the initial set up of their new Android device. COMCO said Google had removed this feature in Switzerland, even though it remained available in other countries in Europe.

Title: Apple releases iOS 27 Public Beta: How to download, compatible iPhones and new features
Synopsis: Apple has launched the public beta for iOS twenty-seven, offering early access to users. This new software introduces advanced Apple Intelligence and an improved Siri assistant. Performance enhancements include faster app launches and quicker photo loading times. The update also brings a customizable Liquid Glass interface and smarter editing tools.

Title: iPhone 18 Pro: Expected India launch date, price, design, battery, camera and AI features
Synopsis: Apple's iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max are expected at a September 2026 event. These new models will feature significant battery and camera upgrades. Performance improvements are anticipated with the new A20 Pro chipset. The foldable iPhone will also debut alongside the Pro lineup. Retail availability is projected to begin on September 18.

Title: Google Pixel 11 Pro Fold leaks: Price, battery, storage, design, Gemini AI features and all the biggest upgrades
Synopsis: Google Pixel 11: Google's upcoming Pixel 11 smartphones may launch without a 128GB storage option, according to recent leaks. Instead, the new lineup is expected to start with 256GB of internal storage. The leaks also suggest that the Pixel 11 series could see higher prices in Europe, possibly reflecting rising global component and manufacturing costs. However, these details remain unconfirmed, and Google is expected to reveal the official pricing, specifications and features at its launch event.

Title: This Qatari royal bought an European villa for $395 million, bigger than Vatican City. The Sardinian estate features 126 rooms, remote-controlled erupting volcano, secret cave to hide from drones and more
Synopsis: Sheikh Hamad bin Jassim bin Jaber Al Thani acquired Villa Certosa for €350 million which is Europe’s most ostentatious villa. This Sardinian estate boasts an artificial volcano and an underground sea cave. The property is larger than Vatican City and features many amenities like a remote-controlled erupting volcano, 126 rooms, five swimming pools, a football pitch and more.

Title: WhatsApp username rollout put on hold after govt notice
Synopsis: Telegram has also submitted its response to the government that last week issued formal notices to the messaging platforms, directing them to immediately halt the rollout of the username feature. These platforms currently rely on mobile phone numbers for user identification.

Title: OpenAI shutters ChatGPT Atlas, moves browser features to the new ChatGPT Work
Synopsis: OpenAI is discontinuing its ChatGPT Atlas browser less than a year after its launch. The company is integrating Atlas's features into its new ChatGPT Work desktop application. This move consolidates browser and AI capabilities into a single platform for users. Atlas helped shape the agent and browsing functionalities now present in ChatGPT Work. OpenAI continues to streamline its product offerings by integrating successful features.

Title: After WhatsApp, Telegram submits reply on username feature notice; both submissions being examined
Synopsis: On Thursday evening, the government received WhatsApp's reply to the notice on the 'username' feature. The reply of Telegram has also been received subsequently, they added.

Title: OpenAI GPT-5.6 rollout begins July 9: New features, models and everything else to know
Synopsis: OpenAI will launch its GPT-5.6 model family starting July ninth. These new models offer improved reasoning and coding capabilities for users. GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna cater to diverse user needs and tasks. Enhanced safety features and cybersecurity improvements are also included in the release.
